_description: Canonical SIMD route ledger for fgf 3.0.2. Edited by hand; checked by benches/simd_ledger.py. Cell default: status=unverified, required=false, perf=unmeasured.

packed-padded.non_bulk_reason: PackedPadded has no FieldBuffer byte form and no bulk operands

exclusions.residue-gf2-8: Residue GF(2^8) has no add operation distinct from XOR

exclusions.gf1: GF(2) dot products use bits family

exclusions.residue-gf2-8: Add/sub on GF(2^8) residue is XOR, handled separately

exclusions.residue-1byte-le127: Residue packing uses prime reduce not pack/unpack
exclusions.residue-1byte-gt127: Residue packing uses prime reduce not pack/unpack
exclusions.residue-2byte: Residue packing uses prime reduce not pack/unpack
exclusions.residue-4byte: Residue packing uses prime reduce not pack/unpack
exclusions.residue-8byte: Residue packing uses prime reduce not pack/unpack
exclusions.residue-gf2-8: Residue GF(2^8) packing is an identity, no separate ops

exclusions.residue-1byte-le127: Residue encode is an identity byte copy
exclusions.residue-1byte-gt127: Residue encode is an identity byte copy
exclusions.residue-gf2-8: Residue GF(2^8) encode is an identity

row-mul-add.justification: 16 GF(2^8) elements per 128-bit vector; integer literal per ISA lane width

row-mul-into.justification: Overwrite is an accumulate with write-only destination; same lane budget

row-mul-assign.justification: In-place scale shares lane width with mul_add

row-add.justification: Row add processes one row at a time; 16 elements per 128-bit vector

matrix-mul-add.justification: Matrix AXPY uses same vector width as row ops

scatter-mul-add.justification: Scatter AXPY resolves to row AXPY per destination row

gather-mul-add.justification: Gather transpose-resolved AXPY per destination row

elementwise-mul.justification: Element-wise multiplication, one row processed as one call

elementwise-div.justification: Division = elementwise mul by inverse; composite scope

dot-product.justification: Dot product over one row pair; accumulates products

pack.justification: Pack canonical elements to bytes; target-basis counting

unit-accumulate.justification: One-coefficient accumulate pairs; separate from general MulAdd

bits-and.justification: 128 bits per SSE vector for GF(2) bit operations

bits-dot.justification: Bit dot product = AND then popcount

map-words.justification: Map word strides; two 64-bit words per 128-bit vector for GF(2^8) linear transforms

encode.justification: FieldBuffer encode is byte packing to wire format

decode.justification: FieldBuffer decode is byte unpacking to canonical
